title: Cyrus and the Promise
author: Ansel Crane
blurb: Mirabel Lockridge, a cellist recovering from one catastrophic final performance, swears the heart is a muscle like any other: trainable, containable. Then a lost letter surfaces, postmarked eleven years ago — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must say the sentence that has been rehearsed for a decade, and time is already running out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
